title: First-year critique of ChatGPT Java Stack code
summary: First-year degree apprentices compare a pre-generated ChatGPT implementation of a Java Stack class with code they previously wrote. They answer open and selected questions and rate the generated code's correctness, efficiency, style, conventions, comments, and validation.
